hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$c" in *"git commit"*) if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE -- '(^|[[:space:]])-[a-zA-Z]*m([[:space:]]|$)|--message|--file|(^|[[:space:]])-F([[:space:]]|$)'; then if ! printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'COD-[0-9]+'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"ccpatch policy: every commit must reference a Linear issue (COD-<number>). Add e.g. COD-13 to the commit message. Tie the commit to a workable COD- issue in the ccpatch Linear project."}}'; fi; fi ;; esac; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking commit references a COD- issue
